# === DCG (Definite Clause Grammars) ===

--8<-- [start:phrase_2]
phrase(+RuleBody, +List)
--8<-- [end:phrase_2]

--8<-- [start:phrase_3]
phrase(+RuleBody, +List, ?Rest)
--8<-- [end:phrase_3]

--8<-- [start:sequence]
sequence(+List)   % as DCG non-terminal: sequence(List, S0, S)
--8<-- [end:sequence]

--8<-- [start:sequence_ex2]
phrase(sequence(["hello", "world"]), ["hello", "world"])       % succeeds
phrase(sequence(["a", "b"]), ["a", "b", "c"], REST)            % REST = ["c"]
--8<-- [end:sequence_ex2]


# === Term Inspection ===

--8<-- [start:functor_3]
functor(+Term, -Name, -Arity)   % decompose
functor(-Term, +Name, +Arity)   % construct
--8<-- [end:functor_3]

--8<-- [start:arg_3]
arg(+N, +Term, -arg)
--8<-- [end:arg_3]

--8<-- [start:unpack_2]
unpack(+Term, -List)   % decompose: List = [functor | Args]
unpack(-Term, +List)   % construct: Term from [functor | Args]
--8<-- [end:unpack_2]

--8<-- [start:copy_term_2]
copy_term(+Original, -Copy)
--8<-- [end:copy_term_2]

--8<-- [start:term_variables_2]
term_variables(+Term, -Vars)
--8<-- [end:term_variables_2]

--8<-- [start:numbervars_3]
numbervars(+Term, +Start, -End)
--8<-- [end:numbervars_3]

--8<-- [start:gensym_2]
gensym(+Prefix, -Atom)
--8<-- [end:gensym_2]

--8<-- [start:global_atom_2]
global_atom(+Name, -Atom)   % mint-on-demand: returns (and creates if absent)
global_atom(+Name, +Atom)   % guard: succeeds iff Atom is the global class for Name
global_atom(-Name, +Atom)   % reverse lookup: succeeds iff Atom is genuinely global
global_atom(-Name, -Atom)   % enumerate global atoms (ordering not guaranteed)
--8<-- [end:global_atom_2]

--8<-- [start:module_constant_3]
module_constant(+Module, +Name, ?Value)   % look up / check a declared constant
module_constant(+Module, -Name, ?Value)   % enumerate Module's own -constants
module_constant(-Module, +Name, ?Value)   % find which loaded module(s) declare Name
module_constant(-Module, -Name, ?Value)   % enumerate every loaded module's constants
--8<-- [end:module_constant_3]

element(?Index, +List, ?Value)
--8<-- [end:element_3]

--8<-- [start:element_3_ex2]
element(2, [10, 20, 30], V)   % V = 20
element(I, [10, 20, 30], 20)  % I = 2 (propagated without labeling)
--8<-- [end:element_3_ex2]

--8<-- [start:circuit_1]
circuit(+Vars)
--8<-- [end:circuit_1]

--8<-- [start:circuit_1_ex2]
circuit([2, 3, 1])         % valid: 1→2→3→1
% circuit([1, 2, 3]) fails — self-loop at node 1
% circuit([2, 1, 4, 3]) fails — two sub-tours (detected during propagation)
--8<-- [end:circuit_1_ex2]

# === Arithmetic ===

--8<-- [start:between_3]
between(+Low, +High, ?X)
--8<-- [end:between_3]

--8<-- [start:succ_2]
succ(?X, ?Y)   % Y = X + 1
--8<-- [end:succ_2]

--8<-- [start:plus_3]
plus(?X, ?Y, ?Z)   % Z = X + Y
--8<-- [end:plus_3]

--8<-- [start:abs__2]
abs_(+X, -Y)   % Y = abs(X)
--8<-- [end:abs__2]

--8<-- [start:max__3]
max_(+X, +Y, -Z)   % Z = max(X, Y)
--8<-- [end:max__3]

--8<-- [start:min__3]
min_(+X, +Y, -Z)   % Z = min(X, Y)
--8<-- [end:min__3]

--8<-- [start:sign_2]
sign(+X, -S)   % S is -1, 0, or 1
--8<-- [end:sign_2]

--8<-- [start:gcd_3]
gcd(+X, +Y, -G)   % G = gcd(X, Y)
--8<-- [end:gcd_3]

--8<-- [start:divmod__4]
divmod_(+X, +Y, -Q, -R)   % Q = X // Y, R = X mod Y
--8<-- [end:divmod__4]

--8<-- [start:lcm_3]
lcm(+X, +Y, -L)   % L = lcm(X, Y)
--8<-- [end:lcm_3]

--8<-- [start:exp_mod_4]
exp_mod(+Base, +Exp, +Mod, -Result)   % Result = Base^Exp mod Mod
--8<-- [end:exp_mod_4]

--8<-- [start:popcount_2]
popcount(+X, -Count)   % Count = number of set bits in X
--8<-- [end:popcount_2]

--8<-- [start:msb_2]
msb(+X, -Bit)   % Bit = position of most significant set bit (0-indexed)
--8<-- [end:msb_2]

--8<-- [start:lsb_2]
lsb(+X, -Bit)   % Bit = position of least significant set bit (0-indexed)
--8<-- [end:lsb_2]

% YES = [1, 2], NO = ["a", "b"]

% FILTERED = [1, 1]
--8<-- [end:tfilter_3_ex2]

--8<-- [start:tpartition_4]

--8<-- [end:number_chars_2]

--8<-- [start:number_chars_2_ex2]
number_chars(42, ["4", "2"])        # succeeds
number_chars(-3.14, CHARS)          # CHARS = ["-", "3", ".", "1", "4"]
number_chars(N, ["1", "0"])         # N = 10
--8<-- [end:number_chars_2_ex2]

--8<-- [start:number_codes_2]
number_codes(?Number, ?Codes)
--8<-- [end:number_codes_2]

--8<-- [start:number_codes_2_ex2]
number_codes(42, [52, 50])          # succeeds (ord("4")=52, ord("2")=50)
number_codes(N, [52, 50])           # N = 42
--8<-- [end:number_codes_2_ex2]
